description: A refined minimalist dining room anchored by a round table with a white Carrara marble top and a dark walnut tulip-style pedestal base. Three low-profile barrel chairs upholstered in cream bouclé with light oak legs surround the table, their soft texture adding tactile warmth against the smooth stone. On the table sits a rough-textured sand-finish ceramic vase overflowing with a generous arrangement of fresh olive branches and green foliage. Behind the table, a floor-standing fluted light oak credenza spans the back wall; a framed botanical watercolor print in a natural wood frame leans casually against it, depicting soft pink and green wildflowers on a cream ground. The back wall is a warm greige plaster tone, smooth and unadorned. Floor-to-ceiling sheer white linen curtains billow softly at the right side, diffusing bright natural daylight that streams in from a large glass balcony window revealing a lush green tree canopy beyond. The floor is wide-plank pale blond hardwood. A warm, softly luminous glow emanates downward from the ceiling zone above the table center, pooling gently over the marble surface and the vase arrangement. The atmosphere is gallery-calm, Japandi-influenced, with a curated restraint in every element.
